SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice
FROM customer c
JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-06-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate <  DATE '1997-06-08'
